explanations.Authored conditions are preserved until: Authored conditions are preserved until explicitly changed. Movement restrictions apply to displayed speeds. Apply the separate D20 adjustment to rolls; ability modifiers, printed roll bonuses and spell save DCs remain unchanged. Situational effects and ending conditions require adjudication. Active items grant their own conditions, one level per item, with no automated effect.
explanations.Authored display organization of equippe: Authored display organization of equipped inventory instances. Placement grants no bonuses or extra equipment slots and does not limit the number of worn accessories. Armor, shield and attunement rules are evaluated separately.
explanations.Authored play state. Awarding and spendi: Authored play state. Awarding and spending Inspiration are explicit edits; calculation and rest do not change it.
explanations.Authored play state. Casting a Concentra: Authored play state. Casting a Concentration spell replaces it; damage records the save DC; keeping or ending it is an explicit command.
explanations.Choose base abilities, species, backgrou: Choose base abilities, species, background and the first class level to calculate the character.
explanations.Named containers group existing inventor: Named containers group existing inventory instances without creating items or enforcing capacity. Membership does not change carried/stored location, quantity, attunement or quick-use availability. Removing a container requires explicitly unassigning its contents.
explanations.Owned instance selection and source-decl: Owned instance selection and source-declared grip. A suspended off-hand item is carried and contributes no active equipment effects; its attunement allocation is retained. Restoration checks the exact unchanged instance. Turn and action costs are not tracked.
explanations.Pins reference owned inventory instances: Pins reference owned inventory instances. Using one reduces that instance's quantity once; item effects are resolved separately. Stored or depleted items remain pinned. Rest and recalculation never replenish them.
explanations.Recorded play value between zero and eff: Recorded play value between zero and effective maximum HP.

explanations.Sum of source-declared penalties for act: Sum of source-declared penalties for active condition levels. Apply once to each D20 Test, including Initiative. This adjustment is not included in printed bonuses or spell save DCs.
explanations.Weight × quantity of equipped and carrie: Weight × quantity of equipped and carried items, plus coins when counted, against the Strength score × the ruleset's capacity per point. Items without a known weight are left out.
